text:
maya: Quick heads-up from a brief SR + keyboard sweep on /models. Found three small but recurrent issues: focus not restoring after closing the details flyout, a couple of tiny chips with insufficient contrast, and NVDA reading duplicated labels on the row affordance. Posting notes here so we can triage.

noah: Thanks — can you paste the repro steps? I haven't seen the focus jump locally.

maya: Repro on staging: tab into the models table, arrow to a row, press Enter to open the right-side flyout, press Esc. Expected: focus returns to the same row button. Observed: focus lands at the top skiplink or sometimes the global header. Happens more frequently when moving fast.

cass: I can reproduce. Also noticed when the toolbar filter is focused then you Tab once into the list, the Apply button gets skipped and focus lands on the first row item.

toni: Likely pattern: we have an offscreen focus trap element that retains tabindex or we aren't restoring focus to the exact trigger element. Two quick fixes: set trap element tabindex=-1 when closed, and call trigger.focus() on close. Also ensure trigger has a stable id so focus target is reliable.

noah: Suggested small change (pseudocode):

```
// on close
flyout.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
trapDiv.tabIndex = -1;
if (document.body.contains(triggerEl)) {
  triggerEl.focus({preventScroll: true});
}
```

maya: Also share: NVDA sometimes reads "Open button button" for the row because we have visible text "Open" and an inner icon with aria-label="open". Fix: remove aria-label from decorative icon or set aria-hidden="true" on it.

a11y-bot: Auto-scan sample: 4 issues found on /models:
- color contrast: `.chip--muted` (#9A9A9A on #0B0E11) fails AA for 12px; suggest token update to #C1C1C1.
- semantics: `.row-toggle > span[aria-label]` duplicates visible label -> SR repeats.
- focus: hidden trap uses tabindex="0" when closed. Should be -1 or aria-hidden.
- announcements: multiple toasts with role="status" cause overlapping polite announcements; consolidate to a single live region.

cass: After the fixes please ping me. My validation plan: keyboard-only flow, NVDA focus trail, VO check on mac, and contrast checks light/dark. I'll also confirm that pressing Esc announces "Closed details for <model name>" (if we implement that).

noah: I'll convert the row affordance to a true <button> with aria-expanded/aria-controls, remove duplicate aria-labels, and ensure the icon is aria-hidden when decorative.

toni: I'll take the color token pass and bump the focus halo for small controls to 3px solid with a slight offset so it stays visible on dark cards. Will run visual smoke in both themes.

maya: Small copy note: buttons labeled "Open" + an aria-label can read redundantly. Use aria-expanded="true|false" for disclosure and reserve aria-pressed for toggle states only.

noah: PR planned: focus restore, trap tabindex fix, convert div[role=button] to button, remove redundant aria-labels, icon aria-hidden, and focus halo CSS. Tagging @cass for validation.

maya: Acceptance checklist to paste into PR: tab order stable, Esc closes flyout and focus returns to trigger, no duplicated SR text, chip contrast passes AA in both themes, icon decorative elements are aria-hidden.

cass: I'll run the test matrix once PR is up. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

noah: Will post PR link here when ready.

maya: Nice — goal is predictable keyboard-first behaviour and clear SR announcements with minimal markup churn.
